label: Signals
text: ST.O.A5.1 — Costly signalling separates types [aos-c04], [negot-c18], [advanced-c13]: a separating equilibrium exists when the signal's cost differs enough between types (uses MA.B.C4 (91A)). Adverse selection [aos-c05], [gos-c07] (as market failure it is EC.O.A2; here it is a counterpart's weapon). Self-selection [gos-c08]. Bayesian persuasion [advanced-c06]. The negotiator's dilemma and unravelling [negot-c14]. Information revealed across stages [negot-c15], [negot-c16]. Market signals [porter-c06]. Information cascades [advanced-c08]. Cursed equilibrium [advanced-c04].

warrant.standard: Separating or pooling equilibrium under stated costs; experimental support.
warrant.defeaters: Costs not observable to the receiver; multiple equilibria.
